description: This file defines the interface for window management in the Starboard platform, including window creation, size retrieval, platform handle access, and on-screen keyboard interactions.

methods.name: SbWindowCreate
methods.description: Creates a new system window with specified options.

methods.name: SbWindowGetDiagonalSizeInInches
methods.description: Returns the diagonal size of the window in inches.

methods.name: SbWindowSetDefaultOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for system windows.

methods.name: SbWindowDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a window and reclaims resources.

methods.name: SbWindowGetSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the window.

methods.name: SbWindowGetPlatformHandle
methods.description: Gets the platform-specific handle for the window.

methods.name: SbWindowOnScreenKeyboardIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports an on-screen keyboard.

methods.name: SbWindowIsOnScreenKeyboardShown
methods.description: Checks if the on-screen keyboard is currently shown.

methods.name: SbWindowGetOnScreenKeyboardBoundingRect
methods.description: Gets the bounding rectangle of the on-screen keyboard.

methods.name: SbWindowSetOnScreenKeyboardKeepFocus
methods.description: Sets whether the keyboard should keep focus.

methods.name: SbWindowShowOnScreenKeyboard
methods.description: Shows the on-screen keyboard with specified input text.

methods.name: SbWindowUpdateOnScreenKeyboardSuggestions
methods.description: Updates suggestions for the on-screen keyboard.

methods.name: SbWindowOnScreenKeyboardSuggestionsSupported
methods.description: Checks if suggestions are supported for the keyboard.
